method: Full expeditions; all quests at equal party level. Two complementary three-person compositions; seeds 101-116 for every three-skull quest, 101-104 for others, independent of calibration. No gear, cheapest compatible head/body, or premium gear in every slot. No rituals. Includes patrols, wounds, death saves, recovery, gear wear, extraction and quest settlement. Does not measure human play or every class composition.
